title: Jensen Huang exit and US scrutiny imperil $3 billion in Chinese AI projects reliant on Nvidia
summary: The projects, stretching from China's wealthy coastal technology hubs to remote western provinces, reveal the scale of continuing demand for Nvidia hardware even as Washington seeks to curb Beijing's access to the technology powering the global artificial-intelligence boom.
llm_summary: Nvidia’s co‑founder Jensen Huang is stepping down just as U.S. regulators tighten controls on Chinese access to advanced AI chips, putting roughly $3 billion worth of Chinese AI projects at risk. These projects span everything from high‑tech coastal hubs to remote western provinces, underscoring how deeply China still depends on Nvidia hardware despite growing Washington pressure to curb its AI capabilities.
